text:
erin: evening check-in — finished first-pass onboarding for synth-small-q. quick summary: onboarding succeeded but evals show a quality regression on the summarization prompt set (~6% ROUGE-L drop). PR for the model ingest is here: https://git.company/synth-small-q/ingest/pulls/42. doing a local sweep to reproduce. cc @sam @jia

sam: on it. can you paste an example failing prompt + outputs? also tagging @kai to watch infra if we need to re-run big batches or canary. :mag:

jia: quick glance at the diff — suspect the tokenizer change in data conversion. when we converted some examples we switched to the new tokenizer config which splits certain punctuation differently. that can nudge summaries. can reproduce with the script below.

```bash
# repro steps (run in repo root)
python tools/convert_dataset.py --input data/raw/synth --tokenizer configs/tokenizer_v2.json --out data/converted/synth_v2
pytest tests/evals/test_summarize_prompts.py::test_regression -q
```

jia: proposed fix: fall back to tokenizer_v1 for conversion of the summarization promptset (we should keep v2 for other tasks). i'll open a small patch.

kai: infra note — nothing obvious from a GPU side, but I saw a spike in tail latency during the dedup job earlier which could affect cached prefix shapes. i'll re-run the nightly dedup and warm kv cache once we patch.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout for synth-small-q v1.3 initiated (10% -> 30%); monitoring hooks active.

erin: thanks. plan: 1) merge tokenizer fallback patch 2) re-run full eval harness (I set temp=0.0 in the harness to reduce metric noise) 3) if metrics recover, promote canary to 50% and monitor cost/latency. blockers: need a quick review + approval for the patch and someone to hold infra during canary.

sam: I'll review and approve once tests pass. small ask: add one-shot fallback prompt for very long inputs (we've seen edge-case truncation causing bad outputs).

jia: pushed branch patch/tokenizer-fallback and added unit test for the conversion behavior. PR: https://git.company/synth-small-q/ingest/pulls/43. test output snippet:

```
=== test_regression ===
old rouge-l: 42.1
new rouge-l: 42.0
with tokenizer-fix: 48.3
```

jia: added a tiny prompt fallback: if token_count > 2048 use the short-summary prompt variant.

erin: perfect. i'll trigger the eval run after merge and post the small scoreboard here. kicking off eval job in ~5m and will paste job id.

kai: i'll pause autoscale for the canary window and watch the dashboards (latency/cost/kv hit-rate). ping me if you need manual rollback.

sam: :thumbsup: approving PR now.

erin: merged. eval job ID: eval-2024-08-22-1187. will post results when done. thanks everyone! :party:
